concept: Private island plots; plot picker and enquiry.

shots.title: Hero
shots.section: Home hero, full screen behind the headline
shots.camera: Eye-level three-quarter view, 24mm tilt-shift, corrected verticals
shots.prompt: Architectural photograph of a private island with a few villa plots and a small marina in off the coast of Abu Dhabi. Golden-hour sun rakes across the facade, verticals perfectly straight, landscaped foreground, clear sky with open space above for a headline. It must feel built and lived-in, not rendered. No people. Overall look: turquoise aerial photography, 24mm; colour palette of turquoise, white sand, green, blue. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Hero for phones

shots.title: Aerial
shots.prompt: Drone photograph of a private island with a few villa plots and a small marina in off the coast of Abu Dhabi, seen from about 120 metres at a 45-degree angle: the building, plot, access, landscaping and any nearby water clearly readable. Soft morning light, true colours, light haze on the horizon. No people visible. Overall look: turquoise aerial photography, 24mm; colour palette of turquoise, white sand, green, blue. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Interiors
shots.camera: Interior, 24mm, eye level, one window light
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate photographs separated by thin white gutters, all four in one consistent style and light. Interior photographs inside a private island with a few villa plots and a small marina, finished in island villa interiors in white and wood, staged and uncluttered, one soft daylight, nobody present. Top-left: the main living room with its view. Top-right: the kitchen and dining area. Bottom-left: the principal bedroom. Bottom-right: the principal bathroom. Overall look: turquoise aerial photography, 24mm; colour palette of turquoise, white sand, green, blue. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
